title: QA wave R2b: checklist run `surface:cli` (8 items) at e4e5c6e3
body:
Part of #9296.
Blocked-by: #9298

CLI lane — no console build needed. `node scripts/checklist-select.mjs surface:cli --json` selects the set (8 active; 5 carry an `automated.ref`).

Execute via the **`checklist-test` skill** + `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` + `dogfood-verification`, in the QA tree from #9298. Own port + own `file:/tmp/qa-wave/<item>.db` per concurrent item. `packages/cli` and `packages/cli/test` both moved substantially in the 727-commit window this wave covers, so treat "the command still exists" as the beginning of a clause, never the end of one — the acceptance clause names the oracle, consult that.

Output: one `qa-run` issue in the RUNNER format (+ `bug` on any clause failure), text only, linked back here and on #9296.
